custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points of the central feed horn struts. AI often fails to render thin structural members connecting to large curved surfaces, resulting in floating or melted geometry. Also, verify if the surface texture of the dish matches real-world aluminum panel construction or if it exhibits 'waxy' AI smoothing.
